title: TemporaryAccessGrants
description: Time-bound, explicitly authorised access. Covers auditor access and break-glass emergency access. Without an active grant, the roles that depend on one resolve to no access at all.
x-notes: A grant is evidence. It is revoked, expired or reviewed, and never deleted.
Actions performed under a grant are tagged with the GrantID in the audit log, so 'what did break-glass actually do' is answerable.

GrantKind.description: Audit: a time-bound review. Emergency: break-glass. Support: a bounded investigation by an administrator into their own technical scope. Validation: Audit|Emergency|Support

UserID.description: The individual receiving the grant. A grant is never issued to a shared account. References Users.UserID

RoleID.description: The role the grant activates. It can never exceed that role's own matrix. References Roles.RoleID

Scope.description: TechnicalOnly is the break-glass default: administrative capability, no business content. Validation: AllProjects|SpecificProjects|TechnicalOnly

Reason.description: MANDATORY. A grant without a stated reason is refused, for every kind.

AuthorisedByUserID.description: Must be someone other than the recipient. Self-authorisation is refused. References Users.UserID

ValidTo.description: MANDATORY. No grant is open-ended, for any kind. Validation: Mandatory, after ValidFrom, and within MaxDurationHours

MaxDurationHours.description: Emergency grants default to 24 hours; audit grants may be configured longer. The ceiling is configuration, never absent.

NotificationRecipients.description: MANDATORY for Emergency. Who was told that break-glass was used.

NotificationSentAt.description: A break-glass grant that nobody was told about is not break-glass, it is a back door. Validation: Required for GrantKind = Emergency before the grant becomes usable

AuditReference.description: Correlation identifier linking every action taken under this grant to the audit log.

UsageCount.description: How many times the grant was actually exercised. Zero is worth reviewing too.

ReviewedAt.description: Post-use review. Every exercised emergency grant is reviewed after the fact.

IsActive.description: Soft delete. Rows are never hard-deleted; history is evidence.
